cases.name: Pamela Sue Keltz
cases.about: Her obituary said, "Pamela graduated from La Porte High School in 1975. She served as the head teller for 12 years at Michigan City Savings and Loan and later went on to work at Meijer for 5 years. Pamela enjoyed playing computer games, especially "Egg Buddies". She was also an animal lover and was very fond of her cats."
